candidate.name: EXACT-PERCEPTRON-MISTAKE-STEP
candidate.law: Given nonempty finite equal-length vectors of exact rationals weights w and nonzero feature x, label y in {-1,+1}, and strictly positive exact learning rate η, compute the exact margin m=y * sum_i(w_i*x_i). If m>0 return (w,corrected=NO), otherwise return (w+η*y*x,corrected=YES). A zero margin must trigger correction for either label. This is one pure mathematical update; no assumptions about convergence, SGD, hidden layers, approximate floats or physical sensor uncertainties.
candidate.input: (weights:nonempty-vector exact-rational, feature:same-length nonzero exact-rational-vector, label:integer ±1, eta:exact-rational>0)
candidate.exact_invariant: When correction occurs: y*(w'·x) - y*(w·x) = eta*sum_i x_i² > 0. When margin>0 both weight vector and identity unchanged.
falsifiers: A margin of exactly zero is incorrectly treated as strictly classified and does not update.
A nonpositive learning rate, wrong vector shape, float, forbidden label or zero feature vector is accepted.
The exact margin gain after a correction differs from eta * ||x||².
The weight vector is changed when the signed margin was strictly positive.
A claim that all non-linearly separable training samples converge violates the restricted Novikoff theorem.
